name: Mitten Extracts Max Pro Disposable | Blue Dream
description:
Smooth, sweet, and timeless,Blue Dream delivers a classic blend of ripe blueberry flavor with subtle earthy notes. This Max Pro disposable offers a balanced, easygoing experience with rich flavor and smooth pulls from start to finish.

Packed with 3G of Liquid Diamonds + Live Resin terpenes for a smooth, powerful experience that lasts. Fine-tune every hit with Flavor, Balance, or Clouds mode.
